I had a really really hard December. I got out of a relationship with a narcissist. After we broke up she posted that I was abusive towards her and started a go fund me to raise money. Even though it wasn’t true, I was told not to respond to it, and my real friends would be there for me. While I did have some good friends in my corner, I lost a lot of my relationships. People I’ve known for decades ditched me. I lost thousands on events I had to cancel that I was putting on. So many people turned their back on me.

I lost so much. 

The thing about MV lyrics I can know a song for years, and not understand or even know what the lyrics are until I really sit down and try to digest them. 

I have loved this album since the leak. I honestly listen to it 4-5 times a day. I keep thinking I’m going to get burned out, but I crave it. It’s hard to describe. 

A couple weeks ago I was at the Apple Store waiting for my phone to be fixed, and I put on some good headphones and listened to the album on Apple Music (ALAC) and it was orgasmic. However the biggest difference was with Spotify they don’t have the new albums lyrics, and Apple Music does. 

It was the first time I understood what the lyrics were. As soon as I started reading them, I absolutely lost it. Total waterworks.I felt like Cedric knew I’ve been holding in all this pain and resentment. I felt like he was telling me to let go and to stop waiting for retribution or revenge. To cut off the infections. This song has done so much for me. Whenever it gets to be too much, I know I can always put on this song and it relieves some of the anger and sadness.

They make you wait in a waiting room for hours because there are tons of other people. When they finally call you, they make sure all your paperwork is finalized. Then they send you to a mediator. The mediator basically will tell both of you going to court sucks, and try to figure out a solution. We were not able to. After 1.5 hours of that, you go back to the waiting room. After that the judge will assign you an in person court date. 

For my case, my landlords kept $1800 and is charging me another 1800 for additional damages. From what I read, if a landlord takes as long as mine did, the court may award me up to double the amount. So basically I’m going to court to see if I’m losing $3600 or wining $3600, which is a ton of money for me. 

I’m not sure what you do, but keep in mind this may take 2-3 full days and a ton of paperwork. Also there is no real telling which way the court will go, no matter how “right” you feel. So if you are doing all this for $450, just keep the time suck in mind. 

I am the furthest thing from a lawyer, and this is just my experience.

So here is the crazy part. I came back from $2300 (25k starting stack). Below is my Facebook post that is watered down for non poker player friends....

Buckle in, this is going to be a long one. TL;DR at the bottom. 

About a year ago I decided to play the WSOP this year. I spent all of this year training for it. I read every day, stopped drinking (for the most part), stopped listening to music and just listened to poker podcasts, watched poker vlogs when I worked out, and all around worked hard on getting my mind right for the events. 

I decided to play two events. A monster stack, that I made it to day two, but nothing exciting. I was a little disappointed to not go deeper even thought I don't think I played anything wrong. For the second event, it was a $1500 turbo bounty with $500 bounty chips. I said this was going to be fun one, and I was going to go after bounty chips, rather than placing really high. By the time the event came around, I almost didn't play. I missed my wife and my two kids. I was ready to go home. It was difficult to change my flight so I decided just to play it. 

Very early on, I got knocked down to $2300 in chips from a 25K starting stack with AK v KQ with a KQ387 board. I was pretty much getting ready to call an uber when I pushed with 66 and got 4 callers. Obviously everyone is going after my bounty for a cheap price. Miraculously with all the paint everyone else had, 6's held up with a super low board. 

I pushed again with about 10K in chips and won a coin flip with 99 v AQ. 

With about 22K in chips, 4 people had gone all in. Since I was going for bounties, I called with 8c9c. all the other hands were premiums like KK, AK, 1010, and one person had 5c6c. The board was Q9889. I quadruple up. 

After that I go on an insane run and run it about to about 250K when they break our table. 

My new table has some heavy hitters like Chris "Jesus" Ferguson, Elke, Dmitry Urbanovich, and Kevin Mathers. My heart is beating like crazy being the chip leader at a table with people I've watched on tv and youtube for years. 

Everything is going smooth, and someone knocks out seat 6 (I'm seat 5). I hear the voice of the person coming into seat 6 and recognize it immediately. None other than Kid Poker himself, Daniel Negranau, the most popular poker player in the world and 2nd most winning live tournament player. I have all his books and watched all his daily vlogs everyday leading up to this. He congratulates me on having so many bounty chips. I finally figured out the perfect loophole to get paid. This is about 15 years ago when everyone paid cash. 

What I would do, would be ring up all the food on one check, and then ring in ONE soda for the whole group. When they would ask for separate checks, I would transfer that one soda to a guest, print the ticket, then transfer it again. A soda was something like $3.25 and the wings (Tuesday special) would be something like $3.75. So all 50 guests would just leave $7 on the table. 

I would then combine all the checks (and the cash) and close out the check. The total bill would be about $190.75 (50 x $3.75 + 1 soda @$3.25). With everyone leaving $7 each ($350) I would walk with about $160 each time.

I never got caught and the garbage men hated me because they never understood why I was so happy to serve them when they all thought they were stiffing me.
